description: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) to enable enlargement of infill extension at ground floor level, changes to side window and doors and minor changes to proposed materials, following planning approval 00222/A/P6 dated 16/2/2018 for Erection of single storey rear extension following demolition of existing outbuilding and first floor rear infill extension.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Tree report, tree root investigation, 1707/PL.00, 1707/PL.01, 1707/PL.02 and design and access statement- received 30/10/19) wherewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The windows formed in the first floor side and rear elevations shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
Reason: To prevent overlooking of the nearby premises in accordance with policy SC7 Residential extensions and alterations of the adopted Local Plan

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The proposals shall be implemented in accordance with the Outline Arboricultural Method Statement contained within the approved Tree Report from Peter Barton Associates received: 21/12/2017.

Condition : 6 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the  side walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
